THE PROPOSED TEMPLATE IS ITSELF BROKEN. This bead recommends rewriting the ~40 reachable messages on the model of R/crossnobis.R:230-232, the only message in the package containing runnable code. I executed that advice and it fails twice - the suggested call omits a required argument, and the object it produces is rejected by the function that suggested it. Detail and reproduction on bd-01KZYJAQ7Y06F5C1P7KG6MAJE4.

This does not change the recommendation on this bead, which is that messages should name a requirement, a reason and a runnable fix. It changes the SEQUENCING: fix the exemplar before copying its shape 40 times, and whatever process produces the rewritten messages must EXECUTE the suggested code rather than merely read well. A message containing code that does not run is worse than one containing no code, because it carries more authority.
